thread:
alex.h: FYI onboarding mixtral-8f-prod-v2 — we're seeing a ~2x latency regression on long-context (6k-8k) workloads after yesterday's kernel selector change. p95 spikes and throughput drops.

maria: ugh. any profiler traces? kernel selector now prefers `matmul_fused_rope` for mixtral variants, right? that depends on rope scaling metadata.

alex.h: attaching short excerpt from the profiler (trimmed):
```
profile: kernel_select -> matmul_fused_rope (chosen)
latency: p50 120ms p95 230ms p99 480ms
kv_cache_miss_rate ~7% on long sequences
```

jin: can you paste the HF config + safetensors metadata you used when converting? conversion script might have dropped some rotary/rope fields.

alex.h: here's the model config we received from customer (sanitized):
```json
{
  "hidden_size": 4096,
  "n_head": 32,
  "head_dim": 128,
  "rotary_emb": true
  // note: no "rope_scaling" or "rotary_freqs" fields present
}
```

sam: that seems suspicious — head_dim * n_head == 4096? 32*128 = 4096 so that part matches. but our runtime expects `rotary_emb_freqs` or explicit `rope_scaling` to pick correct RoPE kernel. absence -> kernel selector fallback may pick incompatible variant.

maria: also saw in logs during conversion: `WARNING: safetensors header missing "metadata/rope_scaling"` — that warning was low-priority so it didn't block onboarding.

ops-bot: profiling job #74321 finished. trace uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/prof/traces/74321.zip (link in thread).

nina: immediate mitigation: we can add a validation step in the conversion flow that enforces presence of either `rope_scaling` or `rotary_emb_freqs`, and explicit check that `n_head * head_dim == hidden_size`. if check fails, fail fast and emit clear error.

alex.h: temporary workaround applied to the dedicated pool: set env `REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=legacy_rope` for mixtral-8f jobs — drops p95 back to ~140ms but memory use + cost increase.

maria: that's fine short term. need a permanent fix: update conversion script to copy HF `rotary_emb` metadata into safetensors metadata and ensure `rope_scaling` defaulted if missing. I'll add tests.

jin: I'll open a PR to conversion-tools with: (1) metadata propagation to safetensors, (2) additional unit tests parsing HF configs, (3) explicit warnings -> errors when missing both `rope_scaling` and `rotary_emb_freqs`.

sam: aside — batching heuristics also contributing. Mixed-length batch packing currently groups by token count only. long-tail sequences cause KV cache churn and head-of-line stalls for these kernels. proposing we add a simple token-time heuristic so very long requests get their own batch if they would block for >50ms.

maria: agreed. create an experiment in runtime-experiments channel and try two variants: (A) token-time cutoff 50ms, (B) separate long-request queue. measure cost delta + p95.

jin: note on KV cache behavior: when head_dim mismatch occurs between model metadata and runtime expectation, we get silent reshapes that degrade cache hit locality. I'll add strict shape checks at KV init and log readable errors: `KV_INIT_ERROR: head_dim mismatch expected=64 found=128`.

alex.h: good call. we've been burned by silent reshapes before. add an internal lint that runs during onboarding pipelines.

qa-bot: created ticket RNF-312: "mixtral kernel selection + missing rope metadata -> perf regression". attached profiling trace and minimal repro model snapshot. assignees: @jin, @maria, @nina.

sam: quick perf note — kernel selector logic currently relies on `rope_scaling` numeric presence only. we should prefer explicit `rotary_emb_freqs` if present (more precise), then `rope_scaling`, then fall back to legacy kernel. also emit a metric when fallback happens so SRE can alert on spikes.

maria: will add metric REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_FALLBACK with labels (model, kernel_requested, kernel_used).

jin: PR 548 opened: conversion-tools add metadata copy + tests. I'll request review from @maria and @nina.

alex.h: thanks. once PR merges, let's queue a re-onboard job for that customer and run full profiling.

nina: follow-ups: (1) add unit test for safetensors meta propagation, (2) add conversion log line `METADATA_OK` on success, (3) runtime unit test for KV shape validation. I'll take (1)+(2).

sam: re batching — I'll prototype token-time cutoff in a branch and run AB test. if it reduces p95 without cost spike, we can roll.

maria: TL;DR: root cause = missing/insufficient RoPE metadata + kernel selector choosing incompatible fused kernel -> KV/noise + p95 regression. fixes: conversion metadata propagation, stricter onboarding validation, metric for kernel fallback, batching heuristic experiment.

alex.h: thanks everyone. small immediate action items: jin open PR (done), nina add conversion test, sam prototype batching, maria add metric + HF parser test. I'll keep the legacy kernel env flip running until we validate fix. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

jin: ping @qa-bot when repro is ready, I'll run end-to-end.

qa-bot: RNF-312 updated with repro link and scheduled e2e run. next update in ~2h.

maria: great. moving to implement now.

alex.h: closing loop here — thanks all.
